verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing site says it can take a described audience or growth goal, understand the underlying customer data, and suggest the logic to use. It also claims predictive scoring for churn, conversion, and value growth, which counts as in-product data-driven suggestions and insights. These are thin homepage claims with no first-party documentation of how the insight or suggestion experience works. missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or assistant workflow, details on what insights are surfaced and how, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
